text:
Type: black picture ledge shelf
Use: displaying framed art, photos and books; living room, bedroom, hallway, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: matte painted fibreboard with a smooth finish
Colors: matte black, soft charcoal
Shape: long narrow wall ledge with a low raised front lip and a tall back rail, a slim groove that holds frames upright, flat profile, light visual weight
Feel: graphic, tidy, gallery-like
Goes with: white or light walls, black and wood frames, light wood furniture; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern rooms

product.name: MOSSLANDA
product.description: The picture ledge has a special groove to keep smaller frames at the perfect angle.
